title: Memoized Fibonacci
description:
Write a function that returns the nth Fibonacci number using memoization (a cache dict to avoid recomputing). F(0)=0, F(1)=1. The function must handle large values of n efficiently.

**Example:**
```
fib(0) → 0
fib(10) → 55
fib(30) → 832040
```
hint: Check if n is in memo first. Base cases: fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1. Otherwise store and return fib(n-1) + fib(n-2).
